changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The commit of the practice repository that the last sync read (ADR 0118).

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The report of the last sync: the status of each practice folder, and the problems of the directory.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The sync report is a JSON object, and a sync stores its commit, its time and its report together. The columns are new, so every row passes both checks.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE workspace_practice_repository ADD CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_practice_repository_sync_report_shape CHECK (sync_report IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(sync_report) = 'object'), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_practice_repository_sync CHECK ((sync_commit IS NULL) = (synced_at IS NULL) AND (synced_at IS NULL) = (sync_report IS NULL));

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE workspace_practice_repository DROP CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_practice_repository_sync_report_shape, DROP CONSTRAINT ck_workspace_practice_repository_sync;
